title: US Military Death Toll in Iran War Rises to 23 per Pentagon Tally
detail: An aggregated headline reports the US military death toll in the Iran war has risen to 23, with the Pentagon tally showing two more service members dead and an airman's death under investigation. Headline only; details not independently confirmed.

title: Report: US Sends 10 Military Aircraft to Israel Amid Plans for Possible Operation Against Iran
detail: Middle East Eye's live blog reports the US has sent 10 military planes to Israel amid plans for a possible military operation against Iran. Live-blog report; not independently confirmed.

media.caption: US military aircraft reportedly sent to Israel
